visualCharacteristics.description: Sticky full-width gradient bar: page title left, horizontal anchor links right, active link pill.

contentPattern.rows: One row per line of columns; every row has the same number of cells. Each cell holds rich text/images.
contentPattern.usedAs: 1 row x 2 cells: [title paragraph] [ul of anchor links]
contentPattern.reason: Fixed side-by-side layout (page title left, anchor link row right) that never wraps into a grid; sticky behaviour and active-link highlighting need block code.

usage.description: Sticky in-page anchor bar (page title + jump links) directly under the header.

reuseGuidance: Use for a sticky page-level "on this page" bar. Links resolve to an element with that id, or to the section whose eyebrow/heading contains the link label.
